शु(शू)र् {c4c} A. (शूर्यते)
1 To
hurt, kill.
--2 To make firm or
steady, stop.
--3 To be firm or fixed.
--4
To be senseless, to faint.

शूर् {c10c} U. (शूरयति-ते)
1 To act
the hero, be powerful.
--2 To make
vigorous exertions; see शुर् also.

सुर् {vI.v} {c6c} P. (सुरति)
1 To rule, govern.
--2 To shine. {vII.v} {c10c} P. = स्वर् q. v.

सूर्^1 {c4c} A. (सूर्यने)
1 To hurt, kill.
--2 To make firm or be firm.
[1] Correction submitted by on 20170209. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/CORRECTIONS/issues/336. note: virAma mis-placed.

शूरणः [शूर्-ल्यु] A kind of esculent

शूरंमन्य a. One who fancies
himself to be a hero.

शूर्प् {c10c} U. (शूर्पयति-ते) To
measure.

शूर्पः --र्पं A winnowing-basket.
--र्पः
A measure of two Droṇas.
--Comp.
--कर्णः an elephant.
--णखा (for
नखा) ‘having fingernails like
winnowing-baskets’, N. of a sister of
Rāvaṇa. [She was attracted by the beauty
of Rāma, and solicited him to marry
[]
her. But he said that as he had already
got a wife she had better go to
Lakṣmaṇa and try him. But he too rejected
her, and back she came to Rāma. This
circumstance excited Sītā's laughter,
and the revengeful demoness, feeling
herself grossly insulted, assumed a
hideous form and threatened to eat her up.
But Lakṣmaṇa cut off her ears and
nose, and thus doubly deformed her; see

-40].
--वातः wind produced
by shaking a winnowing-basket.
--श्रुतिः an elephant.

सूर्यः [सरति आकाशे सूर्यः, यद्वा सुवति
कर्मणि लोकं प्रेरयति; cf. Sk. on

. [In mythology, the sun is
regarded as a son of Kaśyapa and Aditi;
cf. Ś. 7. 20. He is represented as moving
in a chariot drawn by seven horses, with
Aruṇa for his charioteer. He is also
represented as all-seeing, the constant
beholder of the good and bad deeds of
mortals. Saṃjñā (or Chāyā or Aśvinī)
was his principal wife, by whom he had
Yama and Yamunā, the two Aśvins and
Saturn. He is also described as having
been the father of Manu Vaivasvata,
[]
the founder of the solar race of kings,].
--2 The tree called Arka.
--3 The
number ‘twelve’ (derived from the
twelve forms of the sun).
--4 The
swallow-wort.
--5 N. of Śiva.
--Comp.

Me. 80

.

the sun-stone.
